verdict.rationale: Oyster is a global-employment SaaS platform with a public API, so shipping an official CLI is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence covers the REST API, webhooks, sandboxes, embedded web components and llms.txt, but none of it mentions an official command-line tool. These are adjacent developer surfaces and earn no credit for a CLI story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
